# vcp_ssh_key (Data Source)

Fetches information about an existing SSH key by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single SSH key by ID.
data "vcp_ssh_key" "example" {
  id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the SSH key to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the SSH key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key material in OpenSSH format.
